column1: # Arabic (ar) interface catalog for DeckCraft. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   source     the English text exactly as drawn (ribbon labels, menus, dialogs, tooltips); `{name}`
#              placeholders match text the code fills in (`On Click of {name}`)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns, and a
#              trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Modern Standard Arabic, written in logical (reading) order; the interface puts each label's
# words in display order when it loads the catalog (see `i18n::rtl`).
# Clean room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label in ordinary
# computing vocabulary. No Microsoft PowerPoint (or other product) localisation, string table or
# translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product, format and technology names (DeckCraft, PDF, SmartArt, WordArt …) stay in Latin letters.
